# Vocabulary.com

> > An interactive English learning platform featuring dictionary definitions, word games, and educational tools for vocabulary improvement.

Vocabulary.com combines a comprehensive English dictionary with engaging learning tools like Vocabulary Bowl and Vocab Jam to help students and educators build stronger word knowledge through gamification and adaptive learning.
